findings.where: Screen 7, 4(b) after-note, and the Keep this card

'Here 0.02 Ω of the real gap is Ze' never says which gap. Write 'Of the 0.053 Ω gap, 0.02 Ω is Ze: it measured 0.08 Ω against the declared 0.1 Ω.'

'At handover, the client gets six things', but the commissioning notice goes to building control as well as the owner, and the CDM copy goes in the health and safety file. Head the list 'At handover, these go out', or move those two items under their own line.
